P7700.corridor_notes: Two independent official documents describe this exact corridor under the name '吉林-延吉天然气管道' (Jilin-Yanji Natural Gas Pipeline), matching GEM's zh_alt '吉林吉化-延吉天然气管道': (1) a 2013 EIA first-public-notice from CNPC's pipeline arm (中国石油管道公司管道工程第二项目经理部, via 中石油东北炼化工程有限公司) states the route '起点为吉林市龙潭区（长岭——长春——吉林天然气管道吉化末站），终至位于延吉市大兴屯南侧的末站...沿线依次经过吉林市、延边朝鲜族自治州2个地级区域...吉林市段...经过吉林市、蛟河市，总长约136.7km；延边朝鲜族自治州路由经过敦化市、安图县、龙井市、延吉市，总长约173.6km，全线总长约310.3km。共设置9个截断阀室和3个分输站' (starts at the Jihua terminal station of the Changling-Changchun-Jilin gas pipeline in Longtan District, Jilin City; ends at a terminal station south of Daxingtun, Yanji City; passes through Jilin City, Jiaohe City, Dunhua City, Antu County, Longjing City, Yanji City; total ~310.3km; 9 block-valve chambers, 3 distribution stations). (2) A 2019-04-29 formal project approval (核准批复, 项目代码2018-222401-45-02-003878) from the Jilin Provincial Development & Reform Commission to project owner 吉林省能源集团国际管道有限公司 confirms the same start/end and route: '项目起点为吉林市拟建的兴安盟-吉林煤制天然气管道吉林末站，主要沿珲乌高速向东南方向敷设，途径蛟河市、敦化市、安图县、龙井市，最终抵达拟建的延吉综合站' -- new trunk 305km (DN813, 10MPa) + 7km branch, 3 new stations (蛟河分输站 Jiaohe, 敦化综合站 Dunhua, 延吉综合站 Yanji), 11 valve chambers, total investment RMB 1.647 billion. The same approval document also references a related, larger 2017-approved sister project extending further east to '珲春市综合站' (吉林-珲春天然气管道工程, 428km total, via Tumen and Hunchun) -- i.e. this Jilin-Yanji line is functionally the first (western) segment of a longer Jilin-to-Hunchun corridor.
P7700.researcher_notes: IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY TO FLAG: GEM's payload StartLocation for P7700 is 'Yushu', but every source found for the segment name given ('JCIC-Yanji' / zh_alt '吉林吉化-延吉天然气管道') places the true start at JIHUA/Longtan District, JILIN CITY -- not Yushu. 'JCIC' most plausibly reads as 'Jilin Chemical Industrial Company' (吉化 = 吉林化学工业公司/吉林石化), i.e. the Jihua petrochemical complex, which sits in Jilin City, ~100km northwest of Yushu. A separate, newer generation of Yanbian-serving pipelines DOES originate at Yushu (see P7699/P7705's sourcing, and a 2025 duckduckgo search hit describing a Hulin-Changchun-pipeline 'Yanji branch' [虎林—长春天然气管道延吉支线项目] starting at '虎林-长春天然气管道榆树分输清管站' [the Yushu distribution/pigging station of the Hulin-Changchun pipeline] and ending at '延吉末站' -- but that source, www.eiafans.com/thread-1440530-1-1.html, was unreachable in this pass [connection refused, no Wayback snapshot] so it is NOT used as a ref here). Two plausible readings: (a) GEM's StartLocation field is simply wrong/stale for this row and should read 'Jilin' not 'Yushu'; or (b) P7700 is meant to represent the NEWER Yushu-origin alignment and the zh_alt Chinese name is an inherited/legacy label that no longer matches the current routing. Given the zh_alt name is an exact, unambiguous match to the Jilin City-origin project documented in two strong primary sources, I have used that alignment for the coordinates above, but this should be reconciled against GEM's StartLocation field before a route candidate is finalized -- it may turn out P7700 and P7705 (Yushu-Hunchun) are describing overlapping/successor alignments of the same underlying corridor.
